title: 3.3 V rail at 2.5 V
report: On the sensor board the 3.3 V rail measures 2.5 V and the microcontroller browns out.

title: power LED dark
report: The sensor board's green power-on LED never lights, although the 3.3 V rail is fine.

title: temperature reads far too low
report: At room temperature (25 C) the sensor board's temperature voltage reads about 0.3 V instead of about 1.65 V.

title: ADC pin pinned beyond full scale
report: On the sensor board the microcontroller's ADC pin reads far beyond full scale (well above 3.3 V) whatever the temperature.

title: anti-aliasing cutoff too high
report: The sensor board's 1 kHz anti-aliasing filter in front of the ADC barely attenuates at 5 kHz.

title: board stuck in reset
report: The sensor board stays in reset: the RESET pin reads 0 V even with the reset button released.

title: status LED overloads the GPIO
report: The sensor board's status LED is far too bright and its GPIO pin is overloaded: about 59 mA, the pin's limit is 20 mA.

title: I2C data line at 5 V
report: On the sensor board the I2C data line (SDA) idles at 5 V, above the microcontroller's 3.6 V absolute maximum.
